WITH account_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.customer_id,
    c.town_city,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) as transaction_count
  FROM Accounts a
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.customer_id, c.town_city
),
town_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    SUM(transaction_count) as town_transaction_total
  FROM account_transactions
  GROUP BY town_city
),
account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(transaction_count) as avg_transactions
  FROM account_transactions
),
result_set AS (
  SELECT 
    at.account_id,
    at.town_city,
    at.transaction_count,
    at.transaction_count * 1.0 / tt.town_transaction_total as share_of_town_transactions,
    at.transaction_count * 1.0 / ast.avg_transactions as ratio_to_average
  FROM account_transactions at
  JOIN town_totals tt ON at.town_city = tt.town_city
  CROSS JOIN account_stats ast
)
SELECT 
  account_id,
  town_city,
  transaction_count,
  share_of_town_transactions,
  ratio_to_average
FROM result_set
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
